intent: A gothic aurora-priestess ceremonial gown of pale ash and bone white, burnt to charcoal at the hem, with slim sleeves, an open face under a pale veil and a tall violet flame-crown; from the high camera it reads as a narrow-shouldered figure over a tiered bell whose hem is clearly wider than the shoulders.
requests: A pale translucent veil or gauze over-skirt to soften the charcoal hem; the part format carries no transparency.
